Housing support payment date

Shows the days and hours until the next housing support deposit and the following dates in Gregorian and Hijri.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

The deposit rule

  • The 24th of each Gregorian month by REDF board decision, unchanged after pensions moved to the 1st.
  • Friday and Saturday: the deposit was announced the following Sunday in all three 2026 cases; this is inferred from announcement dates, not a published rule.

To work out the financing instalment use the mortgage calculator, and for other dates the monthly payment calendar.

Frequently asked questions

When is the November 2026 housing support deposit?

Tuesday 24 November 2026 (14 Jumada al-Akhirah 1448).

What if the 24th is a Friday or Saturday?

In all three 2026 cases (Friday 24 April, Friday 24 July and Saturday 24 October) the deposit was announced the following Sunday; REDF publishes no written rule for this.

Sources

  • Okaz citing REDF — deposit on the 24th of each month (24 Apr 2024, Arabic)
  • SPA — April 2026 housing support deposited on Sunday 26 April (Arabic)
  • Al Ain — July 2026 support deposited on Sunday 26 July (Arabic)
